title: Scoping review protocol for qualitative public health research in Vietnam
author: Hung Viet Nguyen
materials: Bibliographic details: first author, year, journal, DOI
Study design: qualitative, mixed-methods, or ethnographic
Analytical approach: thematic analysis, content/framework analysis, or phenomenological

steps.title: Define Search Parameters
steps.instruction: Establish the search framework based on the PCC (Population/Concept/Context) framework for the period 2020–2025.

substeps.instruction: Set Population/Concept: Public health topics and health services research in Vietnam
Set Concept: Qualitative or mixed-methods research design and methodology
Set Context: Vietnam, 2020–2025, internationally indexed journals

steps.title: Execute Database Search
steps.instruction: Search PubMed (MEDLINE), Europe PMC (MEDLINE + PubMed Central), and Scopus in January 2025 using English language filters and the following Boolean AND keyword groups:

substeps.instruction: Group 1 (Geographic scope): 'Vietnam'[MeSH Terms] OR 'Vietnam'[Title/Abstract]

Group 2 (Qualitative methodology): 'qualitative research'[MeSH] OR 'qualitative study'[tiab] OR 'in-depthinterview'[tiab] OR 'focus group'[tiab] OR 'thematicanalysis'[tiab] OR 'phenomenolog*'[tiab] OR 'mixedmethod*'[tiab] OR 'key informant'[tiab] OR 'groundedtheory'[tiab] OR 'ethnograph*'[tiab]
Group 3 (Public health domain): 'public health'[MeSH] OR 'health system*'[tiab] OR 'healthbehav*'[tiab] OR 'health polic*'[tiab] OR 'healthservice*'[tiab] OR 'health promot*'[tiab]
Apply equivalent syntax for Europe PMC (TITLE_ABS field; SRC:MED OR SRC:PMC) and Scopus (TITLE-ABS-KEY field; DOCTYPE(ar); LANGUAGE(english))

steps.title: Screen Records for Eligibility
steps.instruction: Import records into a structured spreadsheet and apply inclusion/exclusion criteria to select studies.

substeps.instruction: Deduplicate records using PMID and DOI matching
Perform initial scan to remove ineligible records (e.g., Europe PMC records)

Screen titles and abstracts based on: 1. Indexing (MEDLINE or Scopus), 2. Design (Qualitative or mixed-methods explicitly described in abstract), 3. Setting (Vietnam as primary site; multi-country only if Vietnam-specific findings are extractable), and 4. Additional criteria (English language, peer-reviewed, 2020–2025, abstract available, public health focus)
Exclude editorials, letters, conference abstracts, and non-public health focused papers
Conduct full-text review of eligible records and document reasons for exclusion
Verify consistency by having an independent reviewer check a random 10% sample (n=12)

steps.title: Extract Study Data
steps.instruction: Apply a standardized extraction form to all included studies to capture the following technical details:

substeps.instruction: Bibliographic details: first author, year, journal, DOI
Study design: qualitative, mixed-methods, or ethnographic
Primary data collection method(s): IDI, FGD, ethnographic observation, or combination
Analytical approach: thematic analysis, content/framework analysis, or phenomenological
Geographic setting: urban or rural/highland
Sampling strategy: purposive or snowball/respondent-driven

steps.title: Appraise Methodological Quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate the quality and reporting completeness of the included studies.

substeps.instruction: Appraise methodological quality using the CASP Qualitative Checklist (10 domains)
Assess reporting completeness against the 32-item COREQ checklist

steps.title: Synthesize Findings
steps.instruction: Perform a narrative synthesis and descriptive summary of the extracted data.

substeps.instruction: Organize studies into ten thematic clusters based on primary public health focus using inductive constant comparison of objectives, MeSH terms, and abstract content
Assign studies resisting clear classification to an 'Other cross-cutting topics' cluster
Cross-validate all assignments against MeSH terms and author-stated objectives
Summarize methodological characteristics using counts and proportions
